		has_global_variable = wtp_realm_has_livestock
		has_global_variable = wtp_realm_has_sand
		has_global_variable = wtp_realm_has_wild_game
	}
}
# tannery_manufactory is staffed by burghers
wtp_building_in_scope_tannery_manufactory = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = wtp_half }
		global_var:wtp_half = 1
		global_var:wtp_half = 2
	}
}

wtp_building_available_tannery_mill = {

wtp_building_available_tatara = {
	# special or foreign: not built the ordinary way
	always = no
}

		NOT = { has_global_variable = wtp_half }

		global_var:wtp_half = 3
